name: What is the typical cost of a bathroom vanity upgrade?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost of a bathroom vanity upgrade?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a bathroom vanity upgrade varies significantly based on factors such as the size of the vanity, materials used, countertop choice, and whether plumbing modifications are required. A basic replacement might range from a few hundred dollars for a stock cabinet and laminate top, while custom cabinetry with high-end materials like solid wood, quartz, or marble countertops, and integrated sinks could cost several thousands. Installation labor, which includes removal of the old vanity and fitting the new one, also contributes to the overall expense. Additional costs might arise if electrical outlets need to be moved or new plumbing fixtures are installed.
acceptedAnswer.description: The cost of a bathroom vanity upgrade varies, generally ranging from a few hundred to several thousand dollars, depending on size, materials, and labor.
